purpose.primary: Estimate the out-of-sample suppression effect of the nine candidates frozen by Stage 7 on simulator-seed blocks unused by exploration and validation.
purpose.secondary: Separate intervention effectiveness from optimization gain by comparing every candidate with no intervention, the spring reference, and the exact prior-study package benchmark.
not_in_scope: selecting or tuning candidates with final-test results
pooling network-specific candidates into one universal optimum
declaring one optimization method generally superior
introducing a post-hoc minimum important effect threshold
claiming that certainty and effectiveness alone reproduce the exact prior_high package

objective.name: cumulative_selfish_fraction
objective.scope: Estimate final effects separately for each network and each frozen candidate.

candidate_source.policy: Evaluate all nine frozen candidates without addition, removal, parameter modification, reranking, or reselection.

candidate_reporting_policy.selection_order_1: Primary candidate fixed before final-test execution. Use this candidate for the main network-specific claim.
candidate_reporting_policy.selection_order_2_and_3: Secondary representatives of different Stage 7 regions. Report them descriptively to assess region robustness; do not replace the primary candidate after seeing test results.
candidate_reporting_policy.facebook_limit: Stage 7 found no candidate satisfying its prespecified eligibility rule. All Facebook candidates remain exploratory fallbacks and cannot support a confirmed optimized-candidate claim.
candidate_reporting_policy.test_result_policy: Report every candidate. Never use Stage 8 values or confidence intervals to rerank, replace, tune, or discard candidates.

fairness_rules: Evaluate every candidate and comparator on the same five simulator-seed blocks within its network.
Use the same 100 iterations, retained raw level, agent settings, information settings, timing, and initial-source settings for every condition.
Treat every candidate as network-specific; never apply it to another network.
Use the exact four-decimal certainty and effectiveness values frozen after Stage 7.
Use the exact existing opinion CSV for prior_high and generate only the candidate and legacy_balance opinions from design variables.
Do not inspect a partial result to alter the remaining execution or reporting roles.

seed_policy.final_test_use_policy: Use these seeds once for frozen-candidate final estimation. Do not feed any Stage 8 result back into candidate selection or optimization.

interpretation.reduction: The absolute-suppression confidence interval is entirely above zero.
interpretation.reduction_tendency_with_uncertainty: The point estimate is positive but the confidence interval includes zero.
interpretation.increase: The absolute-suppression confidence interval is entirely below zero.
interpretation.no_clear_reduction: No clear directional conclusion is supported.

inference.multiplicity_policy: Do not convert the nine candidate comparisons into a winner search. The primary candidate in each network was fixed before testing; secondary comparisons are descriptive.
inference.policy: Report continuous estimates, seed-block directions, and intervals. Do not invent a post-hoc magnitude threshold.

interpretation_limits: Only the predesignated primary candidate supports the main network-specific candidate claim.
Secondary candidates describe robustness across selected regions and cannot replace the primary candidate.
Facebook remains exploratory because Stage 7 had no eligible candidate.
prior_high is an external package benchmark and not a condition reachable by changing certainty and effectiveness alone.
The five final-test seed blocks do not establish validity outside the modeled networks and fixed intervention conditions.
